Markets.title: US Treasury yields hit highest level since 2023 as buyback disappoints
Markets.summary: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields reached their highest level since November 2023 due to a disappointing bond buyback and rising oil prices. Strong auction demand later helped ease those yields, while changing expectations regarding Federal Reserve interest rates also contributed to inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Dilip Buildcon shares rally 12% on bagging Rs 1,800 crore LPG pipeline project
Markets.summary: Dilip Buildcon shares surged 12 percent after winning a letter of intent to develop an Rs 1,800 crore LPG pipeline project from Paradip to Raipur. The project grants the company an exclusive license to finance, construct, operate, and collect tariffs for the pipeline.

Markets.title: Jefferies says Adani Enterprises is the ‘platform behind platforms’ with 4 major growth levers
Markets.summary: Jefferies has maintained a Buy rating on Adani Enterprises with a target price of Rs 3,830, highlighting its infrastructure incubation model. The brokerage projects a 23% EBITDA compound annual growth rate through fiscal year 2031, driven by its airports, data centers, and ANIL businesses.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan Nikkei falls as oil tops $100, BOJ rate hike bets rise
Markets.summary: Japan's Nikkei index fell as oil prices surpassed $100 and expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike increased. Additionally, markets are preparing for upcoming U.S. inflation data and the Federal Reserve's policy decision.

Markets.title: India bonds face twin drag from rising oil, US yields
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds weakened for a second consecutive day on Thursday due to inflation concerns driven by rising U.S. Treasury yields and crude oil prices exceeding $100 per barrel. Additionally, the Indian rupee fell against the dollar for the fifth straight day as markets awaited upcoming inflation data and the Federal Reserve's policy decision.

Markets.title: Why Jefferies is bullish on Manipal Hospitals after its ₹9,000 crore acquisition spree
Markets.summary: Jefferies has initiated coverage of Manipal Hospitals with a Buy rating and a Rs 870 target following its major acquisition spree. The brokerage anticipates strong earnings growth from new beds and the Sahyadri Hospitals turnaround, despite ongoing concerns over execution risks and competition.

Geo-Political.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
Geo-Political.summary: Former President Trump claimed that an Iran war and high oil prices will persist until after the November elections. He also alleged without evidence that Iran intends to influence the outcome of the race.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pledges $5,000 to every American - and other takeaways from  Republican midterms convention
Geo-Political.summary: Former President Trump promised $5,000 to every American during his speech at the Republican midterms convention. He also discussed several of his familiar political topics along with a few unexpected subjects.

Geo-Political.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
Geo-Political.summary: A fire broke out on a Philippines ferry as it approached the tourist destination of Coron in Palawan. The disaster resulted in five deaths and left 86 people missing.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
Geo-Political.summary: Declassified documents reveal that Spanish and Moroccan authorities knew about social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before thousands entered Ceuta. Despite these warnings, tens of thousands of migrants successfully crossed into the Spanish enclave.

Geo-Political.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Google is investing €13 billion to build a massive data centre in Finland, marking its largest single project in Europe. The tech giant states that the development will generate tens of thousands of jobs in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Global benchmark Brent crude reached $100 a barrel for the first time since July following military strikes by the United States. The price surge occurred after the U.S. targeted five Iranian tankers on Tuesday amid ongoing conflicts involving Houthi forces.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran War shadow over BRICS Summit? Can host India bridge divisions in the Middle East?
Data & Insights.summary: A prolonged US-Iran conflict could disrupt India's vital energy supplies, trade, and diaspora in West Asia. This disruption threatens to increase India's import costs, drive up inflation, and complicate its overall economic outlook.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
Data & Insights.summary: India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, marking 20 years since the bloc's founding in 2006. The summit brings together leaders like Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping as the coalition has grown into an 11-nation bloc representing 40% of global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Diplomacy tightrope, economic heft test await India at Brics summit
Data & Insights.summary: India aims to advance discussions on trade, energy security, and supply chains at the upcoming BRICS summit. Simultaneously, the country must navigate complex diplomatic relations with China, Russia, and other members of the Global South.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce minister proposed a common BRICS trade platform and a women-focused fund during a conference in New Delhi. The event preceded the upcoming BRICS summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand agreed to conduct a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to strengthen business-to-business linkages to promote balanced economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Brent crosses $100 as West Asia war raises pressure on India’s economy
Data & Insights.summary: Brent crude crossed $100 per barrel due to escalating conflict in West Asia. This price surge threatens to increase India's oil import bill, raising inflation and fiscal pressures.

India.title: Stopped From Entering Pub With 'Gutkha' Pouch, Man Sets It Ablaze
India.summary: A chef and restaurant owner from Nagpur was stopped from entering a pub because he was carrying a gutkha pouch. In response, he set fire to the pub's entrance.

India.title: Bihar Board To Felicitate 168 Inter Toppers With Cash Awards And Laptops
India.summary: The Bihar government will honor 168 top students from the 2026 BSEB Intermediate and Matric exams. These high-achieving students will receive cash prizes and laptop funds.

India.title: Marital Rape: Supreme Court To Re-Examine Law, Its Constitutional Validity
India.summary: The Supreme Court of India is re-examining the constitutional validity of the law regarding marital rape. Justice Joymalya Bagchi stated that marriage does not mean the extinction of a woman's autonomy.

India.title: Debris In Basement, Wall Removed: What Led To Delhi Building Collapse
India.summary: A Delhi building collapsed after unauthorized construction work, including wall removal and basement excavation, had been underway for over a week. The tragedy resulted from these structural alterations to the property.

India.title: Class 3 Student Dies After Falling From Moving School Van In Madhya Pradesh
India.summary: A Class 3 student died after falling from a moving school van in Madhya Pradesh. The incident occurred while the child was returning home within the Vijayraghavgarh police station jurisdiction.

India.title: Rajnath Singh Meets Sri Lankan President, Discusses Regional Security
India.summary: Indian Defense Minister Rajnath Singh met with the Sri Lankan president to discuss regional security issues. Singh also congratulated the Sri Lankan leader on completing two years in office.

General.title: England's mayors to be given power to introduce tourist tax
General.summary: The British government plans to give England's local mayors the power to charge a tourist tax on overnight stays. This levy will allow regional leaders to raise funds directly from visitors staying in local accommodations.

General.title: Trump pledges $5,000 to every American if Republicans win November elections
General.summary: Donald Trump promised to give $5,000 to every American if Republicans win the November elections. He made this controversial proposal during a speech at the party's mid-term convention.

General.title: Migraines and acne among five more conditions pharmacists can treat
General.summary: Pharmacies in England will soon offer treatments for five additional conditions, including migraines and acne. This expansion brings the total number of common conditions pharmacists can treat to 12, allowing patients to bypass visiting a GP first.

General.title: AI is becoming harder to control – can humans stay in charge?
